svg.title: Media Studio target projects, technologies and composition in one repository
svg.desc: Approved target, not a claim that all projects are implemented. The new media-studio-sample repository contains a WPF Blazor Hybrid app, two thin System.CommandLine smart-tool adapters, bounded agent authoring, application-owned review and durable production admission, independent audio production, video production, reusable narration and transcription, opt-in decision adapters, a single Aspire AppHost and the owned Jellyfin companion. Owned applications target .NET 11 and C# 15, while Jellyfin-loaded assemblies retain host-compatible targets. Arrows show logical calls or dependencies, not deployment services. Models propose or infer; deterministic C# validates identities, clocks, output sets, authorization and artifacts. No internal MCP bus, third CLI, automatic model setup or implied audio publication is required.
svg.text: APPROVED TARGET / ONE SAMPLE REPOSITORY / IMPLEMENTATION NOT YET VERIFIED
Projects expose capabilities. Hosts compose them.
Audio and video production are peers; transcription and narration are reusable building blocks.
media-studio-sample
Owned application spine: .NET 11 / C# 15. Existing meaningful project names retained; new boundaries are targets, not a mandatory project count.
MediaStudio.App
WPF + BlazorWebView + Blazor AI
In-process AG-UI; direct typed library calls.
Create / Script-Storyboard / Jobs / Projects.
VideoProduction.Cli
Production smart tool: audio + video
System.CommandLine; preserve video contracts.
Thin adapter over the same capabilities as Hybrid.
audio-transcriber
Transcription smart tool
System.CommandLine; text / JSON / SRT / VTT.
No third narration/audio-production executable.
Bounded authoring / agent adapter
MAF + Copilot SDK + AG-UI + explicitly supplied guidance
Model proposes typed script/storyboard changes; actual diff is reviewed.
No ambient filesystem/skills/MCP/plugins; no executable model output.
Same project/revision identity for direct edits and text/voice iteration.
Application services / existing durable producer
Reviewed revision + output set + stage authorization + admission
Persist project/draft/attempt/artifacts; preserve producer lifetime.
No new queue/database/worker owner; UI observes actual records.
Apply edits is not Generate; candidate is not release/publication.
Independent audio production
Reviewed script -> measured takes -> master
PCM16 WAV + transcript + integrity manifest.
No video Core, visual providers, Node or video encoder.
New composition boundary; exact project name is flexible.
VideoProduction.Core / .Providers
Storyboard -> visuals + narration -> video
Caption/timeline validation, provenance and artifacts.
Keep frozen video behavior; use trusted render workers.
Visual-only dependencies remain on this branch.
Media.Narration
ITextToSpeechClient / MLNet.Audio.Kokoro
Measured immutable speech takes; actual sample clocks.
Shared synthesis, not video-aware project semantics.
Both production branches inject this reusable capability.
Speech and decision adapters below are called only when needed; no mandatory inference on every operation.
VideoProduction.Decisions
Experimental neutral contract + SDK adapter
OpenAI DecisionsClient / retained local Julia
Opt-in routing, video treatment, advisory transcript triage.
Refusal is not uncertainty fallback; no authority to approve.
Provider compatibility and live cloud access remain gated.
Generative provider / agent adapters
IChatClient / IImageGenerator (video only)
Task-specific RoutingChatClient selects eligible clients.
C# bounds candidates, budget, state and output schema.
Decision calls occur inside selection; persist route binding.
C# 15 app outcomes: ready / pending / refused / unavailable.
AudioTranscriber
ISpeechToTextClient / Whisper.net
Validated audio -> timestamped text/segments + provenance.
Hybrid voice calls library directly; no per-utterance CLI.
Used by audio/video analysis when explicitly required.
Whisper implementation is shared, not reimplemented.
RESOURCE COMPOSITION AND DISCOVERY / A DIFFERENT AXIS FROM AUTHORING
Demo.AppHost + explicit setup
One Aspire entry point: resource wiring, readiness and profiles
Provisioning/model downloads are explicit, not side effects of restore.
Repo/package skills teach use; they do not grant execution permission.
Jellyfin.SemanticDiscovery.Plugin / .Core
Host-compatible assemblies; do not inherit net11 automatically
Embeddings / Tokenizers / TensorPrimitives / vector retrieval policy.
Audio item/transcript/index support is not established by video support.
Actual process boundaries, when required
FFmpeg / ffprobe / Node / browser render worker
.NET 11 Process APIs preserve trusted argv, bounds and cleanup.
Not a compulsory UI-to-CLI or audio-to-video dependency.
External Jellyfin server / pinned container
Runs its compatible plugin; retains native access/search/playback
Media + metadata + transcript handoff, not shared domain objects.
Publication and same-artifact audio rediscovery are separately gated.
How intelligence mixes with code
Model proposes or infers -> C# validates identities, clocks and policy -> human authorizes exact scope -> deterministic production.
Two tools, not two copies of the engine. No internal MCP bus; MCP Skills/Tasks deferred. Sandbox feasibility does not enable executable model output.
Target boxes describe responsibilities; they are not all separate processes or a mandate to add assemblies. Completed outputs are candidates, never automatic releases.
